supporting_evidence.summary: significant deviations in scope [all services]: frontend-external_error z=2766990.29; recommendationservice_latency-90 z=1002.19 (5010.9%); recommendationservice_latency-50 z=484.07 (2420.3%); recommendationservice_socket z=106.99 (535.0%)
traces for recommendationservice: SIGNIFICANT change; own spans self-time p50 1.0->5.27ms (5.29x), errors 0.0->0.0; inbound calls self-time p50 3.87->69.0ms (17.84x), errors 0.0->0.0

alternatives_rejected.why: The frontend-external error spike is downstream. Its callee recommendationservice shows inbound caller-observed self-time p50 of 3.87->69.0ms (17.84x) and its own spans rose 5.29x (E2). Its latency-90 also rose 5010.9% (E1).

A pure delay fault would raise latency without a socket anomaly. E1 shows recommendationservice_socket z=106.99 (535.0%) alongside the latency increase, which points to socket exhaustion or contention. A log check could further separate the two.

proposed_fix.description: First check recommendationservice socket and connection usage (open connections, ephemeral ports, FD limits) and remove the socket stressor or leak. If sockets stay saturated, do a rolling restart of the recommendationservice pods. Confirm that recommendationservice latency and frontend errors return to baseline.
